title: RAT-ChIP - Restriction Assisted Tagmentation Chromatin Immunoprecipitation
author: Tonis Org
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.69qhh5w
materials: - Collect your cells of interest and count density using heamocytometer. - Centrifuge 1000 g for 5 min, remove supernatant by pipeting and take the pellet up in PBS at desired density (for example 100 cells or 1000 cells) per 0.5µl. - Prepare 10µl of nuclear lysis/restriction buffer by combining: 0.5µl of PIC (protease inhibitor cocktail) (Roche) 1µl 10x FastDigest buffer (Thermo Fisher Scientific) 0.5µl of restriction enzyme mix (AluI, SaqAI, MvaI, HinfI - mixed in equal volumes) 8µl of 2x nuclear lysis buffer - Mix 0.5µl cells with 0.5µl of nuclear lysis/restriction buffer and incubate 10 min on ice and 5 min at 37°C. - Put samples back to ice and add: 1µl of 0.2%TritonX-100/0.2% NaDOC solution - Incubate 10 min on ice and wortex for 30 sec.

steps.title: Prepare Antibody-Bound Beads
steps.instruction: Prepare the protein G Dynabeads and bind them to the specific antibody.

substeps.instruction: Pipet 1µl of protein G Dynabeads per IP into a standard 0.2ml eppendorf tube containing 50 µl of IP buffer at RT.
Capture magnetic beads by 1 min incubation on a magnetic stand (Diagenode) and carefully remove the buffer.
Resuspend beads in IP buffer at 2 times the volume of beads (2µl per IP).
Add 0.25µg of corresponding antibody per IP and incubate 2 h at RT with end-over end mixing (30 rpm).
Wash beads 2 times with 50 µl of IP buffer at RT by gently pipetting the beads 10 times up and down.
Suspend the beads in the original amount of IP buffer (1µl per IP).
Note: Process a sample with general histone H3 antibody identically to use as an input.

steps.title: Perform Immunoprecipitation
steps.instruction: Carry out the chromatin immunoprecipitation process.

substeps.instruction: Prepare samples by adding 8µl of IP buffer and 1µl of antibody bound Dynabeads.
Perform IP for 4h at 4°C with end-over end mixing (30 rpm).

Wash the beads by gently pipetting 10 times up and down with the following sequence: 3 times with 100ul of low salt buffer, 3 times with 100ul of high salt buffer, 1 time with 100µl of IP buffer, and 1 time with Tris HCl pH7.4.
Capture magnetic beads by 1min incubation on a magnetic stand (Diagenode).
After the Tris HCl pH7.4 wash, suspend the beads and transfer them to a new 0.2ml tube to reduce background (exercise caution when removing Tris HCl pH7.4 buffer as beads may come loose).

steps.title: Tagmentation of DNA
steps.instruction: Tagment the DNA using the Tn5 transposase mix.

substeps.instruction: Prepare tagging mix by combining (scale for number of reactions): 2.5µl 2x Tagmentation buffer (Nextera DNA Library preparation kit), 2.5µl mQ, and 0.5µl of Tn5 transposase.
Add 5µl of the mix to the magnetic beads, resuspend by pipetting, and perform tagmentation for 1min at 37°C.
Wash once with 50µl of low salt buffer and once with TE.

steps.title: PCR Amplification
steps.instruction: Amplify the tagmented DNA using specific primers and a thermal cycler.

substeps.instruction: Prepare PCR mix (scale for number of reactions): 10µl of NEBNext High-Fidelity 2X PCR Master Mix, 5µl mQ, and 2.5µl Ad1_noMX primer (5uM).
Add 17.5µl of the mix directly to the washed beads.
Add 2.5µl of the corresponding Ad2.X primer (5µM).
Perform 16 cycles of PCR using the following program: 1. 72°C 5 min; 2. 98°C 2 min; 3. 98°C 10 sec; 4. 63°C 10 sec; 5. 72°C 1 min; 6. repeat steps 3-5 15 times; 7. hold at 4°C.

steps.title: Library Purification
steps.instruction: Purify the PCR product using magnetic beads.

substeps.instruction: Place PCR samples on a magnetic rack and transfer 20µl of supernatant to a clean 0.2ml tube.
Add 20µl of mQ and 40µl of Agencourt RNA XP magnetic beads (1:1 ratio).
Incubate for 10 min at RT.
Wash 2 times with 100ul of 70% EtOH.
Dry beads for 5 min at RT.
Elute with 10µl of Tris HCl pH7.4 by pipetting and remove supernatant after 1 min incubation on magnetic rack.

steps.title: Quantification and Sequencing
steps.instruction: Quantify the final library and sequence.

substeps.instruction: Quantify the library using Nanodrop, Qubit, or TapeStation.
Perform sequencing using the Illumina platform.
